findings.finalFix: Pinot Noir may also be bottled as a red at Hengst and Kirchberg de Barr since the 2022 vintage, and at Vorbourg since the 2024 vintage.

findings.claim: Rangen is the only Grand Cru on volcanic soil
findings.finalFix: Rangen is the best known of the Grands Crus on volcanic rock, and its slope is severe enough that growers carry washed-out soil back up the hill after storms. The wines are smoky and austere in youth.
